items.title: The Two Basic Technologies of Genetic Engineering

source_refs.note: The two basic technologies of genetic engineering, printed as a numbered list in topic 20.1 (PDF 155).

blocks.text: In genetic engineering, scientists rely on two basic technologies:

items: Recombinant DNA Technology: Physically cutting a piece of DNA from one organism and "pasting" it into the DNA of another.
Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR): Rapidly amplifying a tiny segment of DNA into a large quantity.
